summary: Freiburg's city council moved to raise resident parking fees in 2021, the Federal Administrative Court struck down the resulting length-based fee ordinance in June 2023, and a flat 200 euro annual fee has applied since December 2023. On-street prices rose again on 1 February 2026, while the city said its own garage prices were unchanged. The municipal garage company FKB renovated the Rotteckgarage in 2025, and some central garages were announced as connected to a ticketless camera-based entry platform from 2023.

items.text: In April 2021 a majority of Freiburg's council backed a sharp rise in resident parking permit fees, which had been 30 euros per year since 1993. The gazette says the fee could reach about 30 euros per month on average, with tiered rates still to be worked out by the administration. The same decision approved extending resident parking to Herdern and Oberau and improving park-and-ride.
items.source_title: Amtsblatt Stadt Freiburg im Breisgau, Nr. 790 (23 April 2021)

items.text: On 13 June 2023 the Federal Administrative Court (case 9 CN 2.22) declared invalid Freiburg's resident parking fee ordinance of 14 December 2021. That ordinance set length-based annual fees of 240, 360 and 480 euros. The court cited the lack of a proper legal basis and unequal treatment between fee bands, but accepted a 360 euro base fee as reasonable.
A new city ordinance dated 8 November 2023 set the resident parking permit fee at 200 euros for one year or 100 euros for six months, in force from 1 December 2023.
items.source_title: Amtsblatt Stadt Freiburg im Breisgau, Nr. 852 (25 November 2023)

items.text: The city presented interim results of a concept study on how the Dreisam area in the centre could look if the planned Stadttunnel is built. A traffic assessment by the Autobahn GmbH expects 60 to 80 percent of today's traffic to move into the tunnel. The city stressed that the study is not a final plan and that surface design would only become concrete after the tunnel engineering is complete.
items.source_title: Amtsblatt Stadt Freiburg im Breisgau, Nr. 852 (25 November 2023)

items.text: The city announced that from 1 February 2026 hourly on-street parking fees rise to 4.20 euros in Zone 1 (from 3.80), 3.50 in Zone 2 (from 3.20) and 1.80 in Zone 3 (from 1.60), with a new 24-hour rate in most zones. It said resident permits (200 euros per year) and prices in municipal garages (stated as 2.20 to 2.70 euros per hour depending on facility and day) were not changing.
items.source_title: Höhere Parkgebühren ab Februar - www.freiburg.de - Rathaus und Politik/Presse/Pressemitteilungen

items.text: The Freiburger Kommunalbauten (FKB) announced renovation of the Rotteckgarage (350 spaces, Rotteckring 12) from 27 January 2025: full closure for six weeks until 10 March 2025, then one level at a time closed until 13 May 2025, leaving roughly three quarters of spaces usable. It named the Konzerthausgarage and Schlossberggarage as nearby alternatives.
items.source_title: Sanierungsarbeiten Rotteckgarage ab 27. Januar 2025 (Pressemitteilung, Freiburger Kommunalbauten)

items.text: FKB describes itself as part of the FSB group (Freiburger Stadtbau), running the city's parking garages, and as managing about 3,200 spaces in its own and managed garages.
items.source_title: Sanierungsarbeiten Rotteckgarage ab 27. Januar 2025 (Pressemitteilung, Freiburger Kommunalbauten)

items.text: The FKB press release states that the Rotteckgarage has four EV charging stations.
items.source_title: Sanierungsarbeiten Rotteckgarage ab 27. Januar 2025 (Pressemitteilung, Freiburger Kommunalbauten)

items.text: Electrive reported that Freiburg had about 540 publicly accessible charging points (210 on public land, 330 on private but publicly accessible sites such as supermarkets). The city's plan, as reported, is to raise public-land points to 500-700 and total public-access points above 1,500 by 2030. The article does not mention garages.
items.source_title: Freiburg will öffentliche Ladepunkte verdreifachen – und Gebühren verlangen

items.text: evopark announced that, besides the Schwabentorgarage, the garages Schlossberg P15 and Rotteckgarage were soon to be connected to its mobility CONNECT platform, which uses licence-plate cameras so users of EasyPark-group apps can enter without a ticket.
items.source_title: Freiburg Im Breisgau Is Expanding Its Range of Digital, Ticketless Parking Garages with evopark

items.text: Contipark lists the Zähringer Tor underground car park (212 spaces, Bernhardstrasse 2) among its own car parks in Freiburg.

The VCD Südbaden and the Fuß- und Radentscheid criticised a city plan to spend 9.5 million euros (gross) of city funds renovating the Bahnhofsgarage. The VCD states that a council paper expects renovation of the Konzerthausgarage and Konrad-Adenauer garage to follow in the 2025/26 budget. This is an advocacy group's account of city plans, not a city source.
items.source_title: Sanierung der Bahnhofsgarage Freiburg - Intransparenz und Verschwendung von Klimaschutzmitteln (VCD Pressemitteilung)

items.text: The tourism agency FWTM reported 2.12 million overnight stays in Freiburg in 2023, a record, 4.1 percent above 2022 and 16.5 percent above 2019, while hotel occupancy remained below pre-crisis levels.
items.source_title: Tourismus in Freiburg: Übernachtungen im Jahr 2023 erstmals bei 2,1 Millionen (FWTM Pressemitteilung)

items.text: Galeria announced that it bought the property of its Freiburg department store at Bertoldsbrunnen, changing from tenant to owner, and described this as securing the location.
